title: E-FRC-0211: emission on trits: in the trit-column light a stand-in dimer decays at the husk dipole rate at every...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0211 in the gauge arena: emission on trits: in the trit-column light a stand-in dimer decays at the husk dipole rate at every depth, the stand-in hydrogen at the coupling the depth sets (alpha about 1/77 at D = 16) sits deep in the dipole regime, its full-current rate (1 + alpha^2 / 16)^-4 of the dipole rate, a moving trit charge radiates the linear light's coherent field, and stimulated emission goes as n + 1.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
